column1: # License identification table - the ordered substring rules License.identify applies to a lower-cased "<name> <url>"
# match, most-specific first (so the GPL family resolves before the broad permissive fallbacks). This mirrors the
# build tool's compliance step; it is data, not code, so a new mapping is a line here rather than another branch in a
# focal method. The first rule any of whose tokens is a substring of the match wins; no match is License.UNKNOWN.
# Format, tab-separated: <spdx-id> <TAB> <category> <TAB> <token>[|<token>...]   (tokens are OR-ed, already lower-case)
